about: Rugby League > Jersey tile only (RUGBYJ 2026-11-18): Tripo model rugby-jersey-textured.glb (shape only; its painted colours and its own UV atlas are not used), booklet card 15814 and the client's kit picture (images/592): yellow body, navy raglan sleeves and cuffs, the model's own stand-up yellow collar with a navy band inside its top, our marks only. Colour edges: the borders of the same garment split by Tripo (rugby-jersey-parts.glb), smoothed over the model (viewer/tripo-glbparts.mjs). Tiles wired by hand (the name 'Jersey' is used by many tiles): config/catalog.php and lib/sports_catalog.dart, the RL Jersey tile's look 'rugbyJersey'. The Rugby League Kit's jersey is on it too (look rlKitModel, the user 2026-11-18: old models out); every other jersey and kit keeps its own shape.
